summary: iter100 · Frontend-only E2E validation of the behavior-preserving Fase-3 refactor (Landing/AdminUsers/AdminKYC split into sub-components, Trans/kpis memoised, keyboard-shortcut extracted to a hook, decorative SVG keys stabilised). All 15 acceptance criteria PASS. Zero pageerror / uncaught exceptions across 5 pages tested (Landing, /admin/users, /admin/kyc, /dashboard/vip, /dashboard/profile, /admin/queue, /admin/rates, /admin/currencies).
action_items: OPTIONAL (not a refactor regression): the [data-testid='hero-email-link'] inside <Trans i18nKey='landing.hero.emailFallback' components={[...]} /> is NOT rendered because the current es/en translation for landing.hero.emailFallback appears to lack the `<0>...</0>` placeholder (renders as plain text 'Google boosts...'). Not a refactor bug — the pre-existing i18n string simply has no interpolation for that link. The other 3 email entry-points (header-login-btn, hero-email-btn, cta-email-link) all open the EmailAuthDialog correctly, so email-auth flow is fully reachable.
critical_code_review_comments: Landing.jsx orchestrator (61 LOC) is very clean — pure composition, useCallback wrapping on the two handlers, and closeEmailAuth is also memoised. Good.
LandingHero.useMemo dependencies are minimal (`[scrollY]` and `[t]`), which is correct. `t` is stable per language, so the KPI array won't be rebuilt on scroll.

LandingServices reads bullets via `t(..., { returnObjects: true })` on every render — returns a fresh array identity each render. Minor: could be memoised too, but bullets have stable text keys so React reconciliation is fine. Non-blocker.
UsersFiltersBar / UsersTableRow: pure children (props-only), ROLE_BADGE_CLASSES hoisted to module scope as intended. Good.

useKycKeyboard hook keeps all its dependencies in the effect's dep array (items, focusedIdx, setFocusedIdx, selected, showHelp, setShowHelp, openAction, toggleBatch, bulkApprove) — correct, no missing-dep footgun.
CurrencyIcon: `eur-star-${i}`, `ars-ray-${i}`, `ves-star-${i}` keys are stable and unique per loop (as intended). No React key-warning in console during EUR/ARS/VES render.

ProfileView TRANS_STRONG_MONO / TRANS_STRONG_WHITE and VipWithdrawalForm TRANS_STRONG_ONE / TRANS_STRONG_ONE_TWO are module-level frozen constants — Trans no longer receives a new object identity per render. Verified rendered +5350000000, Under review, Does not match Tron (TRC20), and phone/address in the cash hint.

One nit: LandingHero.jsx line 71 still has `// eslint-disable-next-line react/jsx-key` for the <button> child of Trans — after the refactor this could be replaced with a proper `key='email-fallback-btn'` and the disable removed. Cosmetic only.
test_credentials: session_token cookies from /app/memory/test_credentials.md: test_session_admin_X, test_session_vip_X, test_session_normal_X.
seed_data_creation: None. Only read-only navigation + non-persisted form state (withdrawal address filled but not submitted, profile dialogs opened+closed without saving).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Refactor is 100% behavior-preserving. Every testid (header-login-btn, hero-start-btn, hero-email-btn, cta-signup-btn, cta-email-link, admin-users, users-search, users-role-filter, users-clear-search, users-result-count, user-perms-btn-*, user-stats-btn-*, role-badge-*, admin-kyc-page, kyc-help-btn, admin-queue, admin-queue-live-indicator, currency-icon-*, withdraw-details, crypto-address-mismatch, withdraw-cash-hint, profile-email-row-edit, profile-phone-row-edit, profile-country-row-edit) is preserved and hit-testable. Use `wait_until='domcontentloaded'` not `networkidle` on any authenticated page — the SSE /live/stream keeps a persistent HTTP connection open, so networkidle will always time out.
